world: Soft, diffuse early-morning daylight, approximately 5600K, with neutral contrast, restrained Colombo street colours and gentle highlights. Anudi is a smooth, faceless red artist's mannequin of average height and slender build; the driver is a smooth, faceless blue mannequin of average height and slim build. Their poses alone convey their attention. The setting has patched asphalt, narrow concrete pavement, open kerb drainage, weathered commercial buildings, concrete boundary walls, utility poles and overhead cables. Vehicle bodies, upholstery, doors and steering wheel remain real materials. Every carried object is a plain matte white clay stand-in matching the reference object's size and outline. Draw no lettering or other text.
geography: The family car approaches and stops facing screen right, its pavement-side rear door nearest the roadside cameras. Anudi's route runs from the rear seat through that doorway, then screen right along the narrow pavement toward the office approach and the compact food-three-wheeler bay. The patched road and open kerb drain accompany the route on the street side; a stained concrete boundary wall with a green end pier provides a recognisable landmark at frame right across the successive exterior positions. The vending bay is farther along this same pavement and first enters the picture in shot 6. Keep the roadside cameras on Side A and all lateral travel screen right; show no person at the food three-wheeler.
conflicts: Shot 2's block mark places Anudi walking outside, but its opening picture and subjects place her seated behind the closed rear window. The seated opening is used.
Shots 3–5 have hand notes calling the umbrella open, while their opening pictures and subjects specify it folded. The folded umbrella is used.
Shot 6's block mark and hand note run ahead to walking with an open umbrella. Its opening picture specifies Anudi stationary with the umbrella folded, so the panel shows that earlier state.

The location description and plate include wet surfaces and warm shop illumination. The scene's early daylight and weather progression take precedence: shots 1–6 open dry without rain, and shot 7 opens with fine rain and wet surfaces.

No vehicle cards, vehicle pictures or per-shot vehicles lists were supplied for either the family car or the food three-wheeler. Both remain real vehicles, but no unsupported make, model or paint colour has been assigned.

panels.camera: Inside the family car, mounted at the front-passenger-side position looking rearward across the cabin; seated head height, medium shot, 40mm feel, moderate depth. Anudi occupies the middle, with the driver softly resolved at the left edge.
panels.background: Real muted rear-seat upholstery surrounds Anudi. The pavement-side window is frame right, with a passing fragment of stained concrete boundary wall and its green pier visible through it; dry pavement and dry asphalt outside, no rain. The food three-wheeler is out of frame.
panels.picture: The red mannequin sits against the rear seat, chest directed toward the front of the car, angled screen left in this reverse cabin view, with its head inclined toward the clay phone gripped in its right hand at centre-left below the head. The clay handbag's strap rests on its left shoulder, the bag against the far hip at frame right, while its left hand grips the curved handle of the folded clay umbrella beside it at frame right. The blue mannequin sits at the wheel at the soft left edge, chest and head facing the road ahead, with both hands gripping the real steering-wheel rim.
